evidence.why: Conditional grounded setup and explicit aerial fallback.

facts.rationale: Preserves the direct animation-completion dispatch while correcting the baseline implication that grounded startup necessarily produces grounded travel.
facts.value: Monitors grounded Teleport startup animation and, when no frames remain, dispatches ftMt_SpecialHi_Enter to select the travel form. That selector initializes grounded travel only if its stick-magnitude, floor-angle, and auxiliary predicates permit it; otherwise it converts to aerial movement and delegates to ftMt_SpecialAirHi_Enter.

evidence.why: Fallback entry selects aerial Lost travel.

facts.rationale: The callback's sole guard is animation exhaustion, but its callee contains a ground-to-air fallback that must remain visible in the state description.
facts.value: While startup animation frames remain, this callback performs no transition. When the remaining-frame predicate becomes false, it invokes ftMt_SpecialHi_Enter. The destination is conditionally grounded Lost travel or aerial Lost travel, rather than unconditionally grounded travel.
